title: Amprius Introduces SiCore®500 – High Energy Density Cells for Unmanned Aviation
summary: FREMONT, Calif., September 02, 2026--Amprius Technologies ("Amprius" or the "Company") (NYSE: AMPX), a leader in silicon anode lithium-ion batteries, today announced a new 500 Wh/kg SiCore® cell, designed for long-endurance aviation. The cell delivers 500 Wh/kg at a 1C continuous discharge rate and can be produced on conventional lithium-ion battery manufacturing equipment.
